name: motion-director
description: Use this to make a finished motion video that has something to say: an explainer, a product or feature video, a data story, an article or report retold, a social short, an opener or title sting, or any other film with a point, most often with a voice-over. It works as the film's director: finds the one point and the picture that carries it, writes the narration for the ear, has it voiced with a speech provider the user picks, times every scene to the words, builds the film with the claude-motion
author: JimLiu
